form.label: SSH Threat Detection Dashboard
form.description: Failed-login, live threat-intel and anomaly monitoring for SSH authentication.

panel.title: SSH Attack Activity (auth events over time)

search.query: `ssh_events` ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | rex field=_raw "(?<outcome>Failed password|Accepted password) for (?:invalid user )?(?<target_user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | timechart span=1h count by outcome
`ssh_failed_logins` | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<target_user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | stats count by src_ip | sort - count | head 20

`ssh_failed_logins` | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<target_user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | iplocation src_ip | where isnotnull(lat) AND isnotnull(lon) | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count
`ssh_failed_logins` | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<target_user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | stats count by target_user | sort - count | head 10

`ssh_failed_logins` | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<target_user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | bin _time span=5m | stats count by src_ip, target_user, _time | where count >= 5 | iplocation src_ip | eval threat_severity = case(count >= 20, "CRITICAL", count >= 10, "HIGH", true(), "MEDIUM") | sort - _time | table _time, src_ip, target_user, count, threat_severity, City, Country

panel.title: Threat-Intel Matches (Tor / abuse.ch C2 / Spamhaus DROP)

search.query: `ssh_events` ("Accepted password" OR "Failed password" OR "Invalid user") | rex field=_raw "(?<outcome>Accepted|Failed) \S+(?: for)?(?: invalid user)? (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | `ssh_ti_enrich(src_ip)` | where threat_intel != "" | iplocation src_ip | stats count values(user) as users values(threat_intel) as intel by src_ip, City, Country | sort - count

`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | iplocation src | where isnotnull(lat) AND isnotnull(lon) | sort 0 user +_time | streamstats current=f window=1 last(lat) as prev_lat last(lon) as prev_lon last(_time) as prev_time by user | where isnotnull(prev_lat) | eval hours = round((_time - prev_time) / 3600, 2) | eval distance_km = round(6371 * 2 * asin(sqrt(pow(sin(((lat - prev_lat) * pi() / 180) / 2), 2) + cos(prev_lat * pi() / 180) * cos(lat * pi() / 180) * pow(sin(((lon - prev_lon) * pi() / 180) / 2), 2))), 1) | eval speed_kmh = if(hours > 0, round(distance_km / hours, 1), null()) | where distance_km > 500 AND (isnull(hours) OR speed_kmh > 900) | table _time, user, src, City, Country, distance_km, hours, speed_kmh

`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | lookup ssh_policy_violations.csv user OUTPUT policy_violation, severity AS policy_severity, description, remediation | where isnotnull(policy_violation) | table _time, user, src, policy_violation, policy_severity, remediation
